summary: Iter90fs Support Tickets (bug escalation) - complete E2E validation. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (create/list isolation/detail RBAC/status change/comments/attachments GridFS/assign/statuses/validation). Frontend: admin /admin/tickets page renders with sidebar link, detail panel with events timeline and status-change-select; syndic bug flow works end-to-end (support panel -> mode picker -> BugReportForm -> validation toasts (3) -> attachment via setInputFiles -> submit -> toast 'Ticket TICK-2026-0003 cree' -> auto-switch to Mes tickets tab -> detail panel shows attachment/history -> syndic has no status-change dropdown -> comment posted and persisted). Emails DRY-RUN confirmed in backend logs: To=support@nextgecopro.be on ticket creation and To=syndic_alpha@copro.be on status change.

issues: 3 sequential modals still block UI: legal T&C -> release notes ('Nouveautes NextGe Copro' with curly apostrophe in 'OK, j'ai compris') -> onboarding wizard 'Bienvenue! Configurez votre cabinet syndic'. Onboarding wizard has NO data-testid and its close 'X' button also has no test-id, making automation fragile. Onboarding wizard is z-index higher than SupportChatBubble panel (z-50), so support panel is unreachable if wizard is open. Consider adding [data-testid=onboarding-wizard-close-btn] and/or auto-dismissing all onboarding modals via Escape.

Shadcn Select popover option for 'En cours de developpement' was not clickable via simple .get_by_text; consider verifying option items expose data-testid keyed by status key (e.g. ticket-status-option-in_progress) for stable automation.

action_items: (Optional, UX) Add data-testid on onboarding wizard close X to help E2E automation dismiss it.
(Optional, UX) Add data-testid=ticket-status-option-{key} on each SelectItem in the status change dropdown so tests can click a specific status without relying on FR labels.
critical_code_review_comments: tickets.py _next_ticket_number: uses db.counters.findOneAndUpdate with upsert=True + returnDocument=AFTER -> correctly atomic, no race on ticket number. Format TICK-YYYY-XXXX matches spec.
tickets.py _load_ticket_scoped: chinese-wall enforced by both requester_user_id OR syndic_id match; superadmin bypass; returns 403 'chinese wall' as expected.
tickets.py status change endpoint: correctly validates against STATUSES enum, records event, sends DRY-RUN email; closed_at is set/cleared appropriately.

tickets.py file uploads: streams via GridFSStorage bucket 'ticket_attachments'; size validated post-read (a large body could still consume memory before rejection - acceptable given 10MB cap and 5 files limit but could be enforced at UploadFile chunk-level for hardening).
SupportChatBubble.js: mode picker + tabs logic correct; picker button 'support-choose-bug-btn' and 'support-choose-operational-btn' both have testids.
BugReportForm.js: 3 client-side validations (title>=5, desc>=10, email required) all fire correctly BEFORE server call.
AdminTicketsPage.js: minimal wrapper reuses SupportTicketsList with superadmin=true - good DRY.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin + syndic full E2E incl. validations, attachment, comment)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test tickets TICK-2026-0002 (backend pytest, with hello.txt attachment) and TICK-2026-0003 (frontend Playwright, with tmp txt attachment). Both under syndic_alpha's syndic_id. Both include events (created, status_changed to assigned, comments, assigned). Data has 'TEST_' prefix in titles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ticket collection is db.support_tickets, events in db.support_ticket_events, attachments in GridFS bucket 'ticket_attachments'. To dismiss post-login modals for syndic_alpha, use: (1) [data-testid=legal-accept-cgu]+[data-testid=legal-accept-privacy]+[data-testid=legal-accept-submit-btn], (2) button:has-text('compris') for release notes (curly apostrophe), (3) button:has(svg.lucide-x) inside [role=dialog] for onboarding 'Bienvenue!' wizard. Wizard has higher z-index than SupportChatBubble; if support-panel count is 0 after clicking [data-testid=support-open-btn], first press Escape then dismiss dialogs again then retry. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter90fs_tickets.py.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - feature works as designed. Only friction observed is the aggressive 3-modal post-login sequence blocking the support panel; not a functional bug but degrades automated testability.
